title: lygodium volubile var. lucens
intro: Lygodium volubile var. lucens, commonly known as climbing climbing fern, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Lygodiaceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, as well as providing relief for skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of Lygodium volubile var. lucens include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
